what.en: A crowd crush is when people are packed so tightly that they can't move or breathe well. It can happen at fiestas, concerts, or exits.
what.fil: Ang siksikan ng tao ay kapag sobrang dikit-dikit ang mga tao kaya hindi na sila makagalaw o makahinga nang maayos. Maaari itong mangyari sa pista, konsiyerto, o labasan.

signs.en: There is usually no official warning. Watch for a crowd so tight you're squeezed from all sides, people pushing, or the crowd suddenly surging forward.
signs.fil: Kadalasan, walang opisyal na babala. Bantayan kung sobrang sikip na naiipit ka sa lahat ng panig, nagtutulakan ang mga tao, o biglang dumadagsa pasulong ang mga tao.

before.en: Stay with your adult and agree on a meeting spot. When you arrive, find the exits, the first aid station, and security.
before.fil: Manatili sa kasamang nakatatanda at magkasundo ng meeting spot. Pagdating, hanapin ang mga labasan, ang first aid station, at ang security.

during.en: Walk calmly and follow the exit signs! Move with the crowd, don't push, and edge toward open space. Keep your arms in front of your chest.
during.fil: Maglakad nang mahinahon at sundin ang exit sign! Sumabay sa daloy ng tao, huwag manulak, at unti-unting lumapit sa maluwag na lugar. Itapat ang mga braso sa harap ng dibdib.

after.en: Once you're out, go to your meeting spot or a first aid station. If you got hurt or lost your family, tell a security guard or rescuer.
after.fil: Paglabas, pumunta sa meeting spot o sa first aid station. Kapag nasaktan ka o nawala sa pamilya, sabihan ang security guard o rescuer.

signoff.en: Remember: walk calmly, don't push, and follow the exit signs!
signoff.fil: Tandaan: maglakad nang mahinahon, huwag manulak, at sundin ang exit sign!
